principles: vary one designated BLUE agent and one causal phase while coupling every other sampling stream across replicas
train sender BROADCAST spans on sender-focused handoffs and receiver ACT spans on receiver-focused handoffs
assign verified terminal-return advantage only to the designated agent; never reward speaking or matching a target directly
retain matched decoys so irrelevant or misleading broadcasts can receive ordinary game consequences
retain ordinary games so communication learning cannot replace basic tactical competence
reuse the unchanged frozen 192-game development pulse every ten updates

stages.name: joint_channel_warmup
stages.purpose: introduce clean receiver-action and sender-broadcast credit while preserving tactical density

stages.name: joint_channel_acquisition
stages.purpose: give both halves of the information handoff repeated terminal-return learning signal

stages.name: joint_communication_reliance
stages.purpose: make private-information handoffs the dominant source of policy updates without adding a message bonus

stages.name: joint_consolidation
stages.purpose: retain ordinary tactics while testing whether the learned sender-receiver channel survives mixed play

checkpoint_selection: select once from development metrics after update 80
frozen_policy: the existing rl_v4 frozen OOD evaluation remains unopened and byte-identical
